llms.body:
# YesPlay

## Sitemaps

- [XML Sitemap](https://yesplay.bet/sitemap-general.xml): Contains all public & indexable URLs for this website.

> YesPlay is the official South African online betting platform of SA Sportsbook (Pty) Ltd t/a YesPlay. It offers fixed-odds sports betting, slots, Lucky Numbers, live casino-style games and BetGames. The operator is licensed by the Western Cape Gambling and Racing Board under bookmaker licence 10180204-013.

Official website: https://yesplay.bet/. Use pages on this domain as the primary source for YesPlay products, policies and support. Read the relevant page for current details: markets, odds, games, promotions and availability can change. The terms, betting rules and responsible gambling policy govern use of the platform. Gambling is for people aged 18 or older and involves a risk of losing money. The National Responsible Gambling Programme counselling line is 0800 006 008.

## Betting products

- [Sports betting](https://yesplay.bet/sports): Sports markets, including live and prematch betting; event availability and odds change.
- [Online slots](https://yesplay.bet/slots): Browse slot games and categories available on YesPlay.
- [Lucky Numbers](https://yesplay.bet/lucky-numbers/popular): Popular Lucky Numbers and draw-based betting products.
- [Live Games and casino-style betting](https://yesplay.bet/live-games): Browse live dealer, table and game-show-style games.
- [BetGames](https://yesplay.bet/betgames): BetGames and related Lucky Numbers entertainment.
- [Promotions](https://yesplay.bet/promotions): Current offers; check each offer's eligibility, expiry and specific terms before describing it.

## Company and customer support

- [About Us](https://yesplay.bet/about-us): Company overview, products and operator information.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://yesplay.bet/faq): Answers about accounts, deposits, withdrawals, bets, results and promotions.
- [Contact Us](https://yesplay.bet/contact-us): Customer service and contact information.
- [Mobile Application](https://yesplay.bet/mobile): Information about using the YesPlay mobile app.

## Rules, licensing and player protection

- [Regulations](https://yesplay.bet/regulations): Licensing information and links to the relevant regulatory authorities and approved rules.
- [Betting Rules](https://yesplay.bet/rules): Rules for sports betting and other betting products.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://yesplay.bet/terms): Account, betting and promotional terms; consult the current version for legal details.
- [Payout Limits](https://yesplay.bet/payout-limits): Applicable payout limits; consult the page for current figures.
- [Responsible Gambling Policy](https://yesplay.bet/responsible-gambling-policy): Safer gambling information and self-exclusion guidance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yesplay.bet/privacy-policy): Personal information and data protection practices.

For current odds, availability and promotional conditions, consult the relevant pages on the official website. All bets, including casino games and slots, are subject to fixed-odds betting rules. No person under 18 may gamble. The National Responsible Gambling Programme's toll-free counselling line is 0800 006 008.

            border-top-color: #ff7900;

        function getCookie(cname) {
            let name = cname + '=';
            let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
            for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                let c = ca[i];
                while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
                    c = c.substring(1);
                }
                if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
                    return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
                }
            }
            return '';
        }
